mail.title: Thinking of you, wherever you are
mail.body:
Dear Kingston,

As the season changes, we wanted to reach out and say hello. Wherever life has taken you since graduation, you remain part of the University of Toronto community.

If you're going through a busy or difficult time, please remember that confidential wellness support and career advising are available to alumni at no cost. We'd also love to hear what you're up to.

Warm regards,
Alumni Relations
University of Toronto

mail.title: Checking in: how are you doing?
mail.body:
Hi Kingston,

We know that moving to a new city or starting a new chapter can be exciting — and a little overwhelming. We just wanted to check in and see how you're doing.

Our global alumni network is here for you, from local meetups to one-on-one mentorship. Just reply to this email if there's anything we can help with.

Take care,
Alumni Relations
University of Toronto
